testimony.key_claims: Patent received December 1919 at the Agency. Accepted without protest. Has mortgaged the land (one mortgage, one more at some time). Has not sold the land. Land has not been sold for debts or taxes. Patent has not been cancelled. No tax assessments cancelled or refunded. Allottee is 45 years old, is crippled (possibly losing a leg) due to tobacco or other cause. Is a farmer and has not received any government, state, or county support. No dependents other than himself. Has not been defrauded by anyone.
